title: Emerald Palm Vacation Rental
meta_description: Emerald Palm is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionEmerald PalmRosemary Beach CommunitySt. Augustine St., Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights2 bedrooms + hallway bunk area (see room configurations by selecting the “Room Details” tab above)2 bathrooms1,191 sq. ft.Sleeps 6 guestsWraparound porch overlooking St. Augustine Green and the state-of-the-art amphitheaterFully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar and dining area2nd-floor unit with elevator and stairs2 parking passes ONLY (per HOA; no additional passes permitted)Two 26” adult bikes included seasonally (Bikes not included Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Property OverviewWelcome to Emerald Palm, a newly renovated (Fall 2024) 2-bedroom condo perfectly nestled in the heart of the Rosemary Beach Community. Overlooking the beautiful St. Augustine Green, guests enjoy a front-row view of one of Rosemary’s most beloved gathering spaces—often home to family-friendly events and live music at the amphitheater.Just a short walk from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf, this bright and inviting condo comfortably accommodates up to six guests. The thoughtfully refreshed interiors include warm, coastal-inspired design, spacious living areas, and two modern bathrooms for convenience.A fully equipped kitchen opens to both the breakfast bar and dining area, making it easy to prepare and enjoy meals together. After a day of beach adventures or exploring 30A, unwind in the cozy living space or step out onto the wraparound porch to take in the peaceful community views.Whether you’re here for relaxation, local events, or a mix of both, Emerald Palm is the perfect home base for experiencing the best of Rosemary Beach.Looking for additional nearby accommodations?Check out The Front Row on our website—it’s located in the same building.Community AmenitiesRosemary Beach offers a luxurious, walkable coastal experience filled with charm and convenience. Enjoy:Four community pools (some heated seasonally)Private community beach accessRosemary Square with boutique shopping and incredible diningPlaygroundMultiple parks & green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian pathways throughout the communityLush landscapingFitness center & racquet club (available for an additional fee)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in the Rosemary Beach community.ParkingEmerald Palm does not have designated parking. Guests may use the parking lot behind the building and permitted on-street parking in lined spaces in front of the condo.Important Parking Notes:Only 2 parking passes are issued per the HOA—no exceptions or extras.Parking in Rosemary Beach can be limited.On-street parking is first-come, first-served and requires a valid parking pass/hang tag.Garage or driveway parking (if available at other homes) may not fit oversized vehicles.The Rosemary Beach Property Owners Association strictly enforces all parking rules.30A Cottages is not liable for fines or towing.Reservation & Booking PoliciesThe cancellation policy and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement (emailed at booking) override any policies shown on third-party sites.Third-party service fees are non-refundable.A 5% cancellation fee applies to all cancellations to cover processing costs.We do not offer a 100% refund at any time after a booking is processed.Rental Terms:No SmokingNo Pets Allowed (excluding certified service animals; advance notice and documentation required)Published rates do not include taxes and fees50% of the total cost is due at bookingRemaining balance due 30 days before arrival (or paid in full if arrival is within 30 days)Except for the 5% fee, the initial 50% is refundable if cancellation is made more than 30 days prior to arrivalOptional travel insurance is available (must be purchased before final payment or when paying in full)Check-in begins at 4:00 PM CST; check-out is by 10:00 AMTenant must be at least 25 years old and present for the entire stay; keys will not be issued to anyone under 25
